description: As a retired elementary public school teacher, I saw firsthand how public schools need the adequate amount of funding to ensure small class sizes, resources for students, and high quality staffing. With Scott Walker's Act 10 I saw my classes almost double in size and a public attack on the teaching profession that I would never have imagined possible. I know we can count on Robyn to invest in our public school system, especially during the current crisis of education during COVID.
